# Prompt library

Every prompt in this library, in pipeline order. Each page shows the prompt text, what it needs, its placeholders, and the guide pages that use it.

These pages are generated from the files in `prompts/`. Edit a source file and run `python3 scripts/site/sync.py --write`; never edit a page here by hand.
